Calculate ${\int }_{C}\,\text{d}s,$ where $C$ is the line segment shown above.
question.:question/worked-solution:
The line integral of unity with respect to arc length over $C$ is equal to the arc length $L$ of $C,$ i.e.,

$$
{\int }_{C}\,\text{d}s=L.
$$

In this case, the path $C$ is the hypotenuse of a right triangle whose legs have lengths $2$ and $8.$ Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}L & =\sqrt{{2}^{2}+{8}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{4+64} \\  & =\sqrt{68} \\  & =2\sqrt{17}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
{\int }_{C}\,\text{d}s=2\sqrt{17}.
$$

$$

$$

Therefore,

$$
\int_C \,\textrm d s = 6 \pi.
$$
